digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and rubric (G7 criterion)
propositions: G7 routing entry must flip from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.85 to enable plan-review blocking for floor-grade findings at validity >= 0.85.
Plan-review blocking derives only from default_posture='blocking' plus block_threshold; no new Pass-3 per-grade machinery is added.

G7 rubric must gain four rules: abstain-on-unresolvable-parent (fail-open), closed-parent-final-state + sibling-handoff (no leaf violation), one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause (dedup-at-source), and floor-kind guidance (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site block; incomplete_enumeration advisory).

At 0.85 threshold with plan-v4 divergence grading, contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor impact at 0.85 and can block at high validity; incomplete_enumeration contributes 0.55 and cannot reach the blocking bar via divergence axis.

FP verification over 348 historical G7 findings showed 0 clearly-incorrect at priority >= 0.85, supporting kind-blind blocking of the entire floor-grade band rather than restricting to contradicts_reality alone.

Test suite must verify threshold_for returns (0.85, True), floor-kind findings block via real orchestrator+impact_plan, incomplete_enumeration stays advisory, and all rubric-text sentences are present.
